on_image_sentence: Never ask the man selling umbrellas whether a storm is coming.
art_concept: An umbrella merchant advises listeners under a completely clear sky.
caption: People often give advice that serves their interests. Understand incentives before trusting recommendations.

on_image_sentence: Put down what was never yours to carry.
art_concept: A woman sets down overfull suitcases that others placed upon her.
caption: People can become so accustomed to benefiting from your sacrifices that they experience your boundaries as betrayal.

on_image_sentence: Do not confuse the silence of fear with the peace of respect.
art_concept: A lion sits at ease while several animals hide at the edge of the illustration.
caption: Fear often creates the appearance of harmony. Real respect does not require silence, submission, or the absence of truth.

on_image_sentence: Choose the sky before the cage begins to look like home.
art_concept: One calm bird perches in an open cage.
caption: Familiar limits can become comfortable enough that freedom starts to feel frightening. The longer you stay, the harder leaving can feel.

on_image_sentence: Do not sleep too deeply beside what has already shown you its teeth.
art_concept: An awake lamb curls beside a peacefully sleeping wolf.
caption: Harm can outlast remorse, and safety should never be rushed for the sake of peace.

on_image_sentence: Do not thank the fence until you know which side of it you may need.
art_concept: A sheep gazes across a wooden fence, barred from the distant field.
caption: Every protection can carry a hidden cost. Safety and freedom sometimes pull in opposite directions.

on_image_sentence: Leave the harbor before safety convinces you it is the whole world.
art_concept: One wooden boat remains tied to an empty jetty facing open water.
caption: Comfort can become confinement when it keeps you from taking worthwhile risks.

on_image_sentence: Search the pockets of the man who always arrives first with the cure.
art_concept: Celebrated healer accepts flowers with a concealed source of sickness in his pocket.
caption: People who profit from a problem may have incentives to keep it from being solved.

on_image_sentence: Never trust a ruler who punishes the truth and then celebrates order.
art_concept: A pleased monarch reads only glowing dispatches while smoke rises outside.
caption: Punishing bad news makes people hide problems instead of solving them.

on_image_sentence: Do not wear the mask so long that your reflection starts to trust it.
art_concept: A plain mask lies beside a mirror, the reflection shows only the mask.
caption: Performing for approval can slowly replace a clear sense of who you are.

on_image_sentence: Do not mistake busyness for progress.
art_concept: An animal runs on a wheel while a path outside remains empty.
caption: Motion and effort are not the same as getting closer to a meaningful goal.

on_image_sentence: Let the trembling hand reach for the door anyway.
art_concept: A hand hesitates on a door handle opening to daylight.
caption: Courage does not require the absence of fear; it requires acting for something worthwhile despite it.
